chunks: And whatever is in it from Ḥamdān al-Dīwānī, I have narrated it from Aḥmad ibn Ziyād ibn Jaʿfar al-Hamadānī—may Allah be pleased with him—from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm ibn Hāshim, from his father, from Ḥamdān al-Dīwānī.

key_terms.رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: An honorific meaning: may Allah be pleased with him.
key_terms.عَنْ أَبِيهِ: Indicates transmission from his father within the chain.
key_terms.فَقَدْ رَوَيْتُهُ: A transmission phrase meaning: I have narrated it.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Ḥamdān al-Dīwānī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Ḥamdān al-Dīwānī. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission for hadith attribution in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh.
